messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate detected for prod canary group after model rollout (model=v2.3). 5xx delta +4.8% vs baseline. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/canary/overview?model=v2.3

akshay: taking pager — oncall akshay. quick snapshot: error spike starts ~14:00 UTC, affects canary traffic (~2% of total), observed higher latency and increased token counts for requests hitting v2.3. will collect logs + diffs.

maria: logging the canary diff I pulled. token-length distribution shifted right for v2.3 vs v2.2 (median tokens 120 -> 210). suspect decoding change.

maria: diff summary: 
```
metric                v2.2    v2.3    delta
avg_tokens            135     248     +113
median_tokens         120     210     +90
p95_latency_ms        230     520     +290
5xx_rate_pct          0.7%    5.5%    +4.8pp
```

akshay: sharing a few log samples from canary hosts (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:01Z] req=req-0a1 model=v2.3 latency=480ms status=200 tokens_out=402
[2026-03-15T14:02:04Z] req=req-0b2 model=v2.3 latency=130ms status=500 error="runtime: kv-cache-evict-failure"
[2026-03-15T14:02:05Z] req=req-0c3 model=v2.3 latency=740ms status=200 tokens_out=621
[2026-03-15T14:03:12Z] req=req-0d4 model=v2.3 latency=90ms status=500 error="quant-kernel-exec-fault"
```

pradeep: fyi I see correlated spike in memory reclaim on canary GPUs at same timestamps — oom-reclaim cycles and increased memcpy retries in the kernel logs. attaching node snippet: 
```
GPU0: mem_used=14.8G mem_total=16.0G page_faults=1544 memcpy_errors=3
CPU: swap_used=0.5G
```

eva: quick check — rollout config shows sampling tweaks for v2.3 (top-k 50 -> top-k 80) and decoding temperature bump. that could explain longer outputs. I also see a different quant profile used (int8-8q vs int8-4q).

akshay: hypothesis tracker: 
- H1: decoding/sampling changes -> > tokens per request -> KV cache thrash -> higher latency and 5xx. 
- H2: new quantization kernel used by v2.3 is unstable on certain GPU driver combos -> kernel faults -> 500s.
- H3: routing bug sending some heavier traffic to canary region causing resource contention.

maria: quick repro: ran same prompt against v2.2 and v2.3, got ~2x token output on v2.3 consistently. sample: 
```
# prompt: "Summarize the following..."
-> v2.2 tokens: 98
-> v2.3 tokens: 212
```

julie: I'm oncall next, taking over in 10m. akshay — recommend immediate rollback of the canary to v2.2 and open a controlled redeploy once we validate token growth cause. can we pin canary traffic while we rollback?

akshay: agreed. pinning commands: `rcli rollout rollback --model v2.3 --target canary --to v2.2 --reason "observed 5xx + latency after sampling change"`

akshay: running rollback now.

incident-bot: Action: rollback started by akshay at 2026-03-15T14:12:10Z. Estimated completion 2m.

sre-bot: Pre-checks passed: healthchecks green, enough capacity to host v2.2.

akshay: rollback completed 14:14 UTC. monitoring...

maria: post-rollback metrics: within 8m, 5xx rate down from 5.5% to 0.9%, p95 latency back to ~240ms.

akshay: customer impact summary: ~12 interactive sessions experienced >50% error rates; three API customers (cust-42, cust-77, cust-88) saw transient 30-60% error rates for ~7-12 minutes. we've sent interim notif to SRE-Delivery and account teams.

julie: good containment. marking mitigation: rollback to v2.2 — status: success.

pradeep: kernel error counts dropped to baseline after rollback, memory reclaim events decreased. logs look clean.

eva: short term verdict: decoding/sampling change is likely root contributor (H1) given token growth and correlation with mem pressure, but H2 still plausible — quant profile difference lines up with kernel faults seen. need deeper repro on quant config + driver matrix.

akshay: next steps / action items: 
- (akshay) create formal incident doc and timeline (RCA draft) by EOD.
- (maria) run A/B test on decoding params in staging and add average token length as canary gating metric.
- (pradeep) run quant kernel regression tests across driver versions and tabulate failures.
- (eva) add smoke test that asserts per-request token distribution doesn't exceed historical 99th percentile by >2x.
- (julie) coordinate customer follow-ups + postmortem.

maria: adding note: deploy pipeline currently doesn't gate on token-length. we'll add a gating check to Redwood Optimize recommendations too.

julie: assigning owners in the incident doc. will follow up in #postmortems with link once it's created.

akshay: handoff: I'm clear now, passing to julie for RCA write-up + follow-ups. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed for pager group at 2026-03-15T15:30:00Z. Final state: mitigated (rollback). Severity: P2 (customer-impacting, limited scope).

julie: note for RCA: timeline + logs + canary-diff plots + kernel repro steps. Proposed postmortem labels: regression, rollout-gating, quant-kernels.

pradeep: tagging infra for a deeper kernel investigation — will share findings in the RCA.

maria: uploaded canary diff plots and sample prompts to the incident doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/1862000000-rlc-canary-diff

julie: thanks all — we'll follow up with a proper RCA and action tracking.
